messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman turns her head from a side profile to face the camera, then raises her hand to touch her hair before turning her head away again.","camera":"The camera maintains a medium close-up, eye-level shot of the subject, remaining relatively static as she moves.","clothing":"She wears a bright pink, off-the-shoulder top with black straps and a black graphic design on the sleeve.","hair_color":"The hair is dark brown or black with a prominent blonde highlight in the bangs.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled back into a high ponytail with short, straight bangs across her forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin, a slender build, and a small gold hoop earring in her visible ear.","scene":"The setting is a futuristic, neon-lit environment at night, featuring a large glass dome structure with pink and blue lighting in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's full-body rear/side view with a static medium close-up of the woman's head and shoulders. She is shown from the front/side, turns her head, and raises a hand toward her hair, with the same futuristic dome scene behind her. The framing is close but not an extreme face-only close-up, and the initial view is more side-profile than the reference's exact placement.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a close-up of the person's face from the front, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing while preserving appearance, expression, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the initial subject placement and viewing direction exactly match the provided reference image.
Whether the facial expression and action timing were preserved precisely despite the changed framing.
unexpected_changes: The person's clothing details changed: the source's white skirt and black boots are no longer visible, and the top now shows black straps and a black sleeve graphic not clearly present in the source.
The hair appears to have a prominent blonde highlight in the bangs, which is not clearly visible in the source.
The action progression differs from the source: the source shows a full-body turn and pose, while the output shows head turns and hand-to-hair movement in a close-up.
